Payout of 29 July is short ₹5,900.41.
The bank credited ₹1,47,687.86 against an expected ₹1,53,588.27. 26 orders sit in this payout. 5 different combinations of ledger entries add up to this difference and nothing in the records tells them apart, so no single explanation can be given.
Suggested action: ask the gateway which entries it deducted from this payout, since the amounts alone cannot separate them.
